theorems.name: Submission.dorag_dbs_localized_density_point
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (W s : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)), IsOpen W → MeasurableSet s → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ W → ν K ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂ν.restrict s, x ∈ W → ∀ a : ℝ, a < 1 → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal a * ν (closedBall x t) ≤ ν (s ∩ closedBall x t)
